original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚NSCDC与EFCC共享情报以打击贡贝州犯罪
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚安全与民防部队（NSCDC）与经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）承诺加强情报共享与行动协作，以打击贡贝州的经济金融犯罪及其他犯罪活动。NSCDC州指挥官穆罕默德·乌斯曼率高级管理人员代表团访问EFCC贡贝区域局时作出上述承诺。双方将情报信息共享、联合行动和能力建设列为需要加强合作的关键领域。

key_facts.fact: NSCDC与EFCC承诺加强情报共享和行动协作以打击贡贝州犯罪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps and the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission have pledged to strengthen intelligence sharing and operational collaboration to combat economic and financial crimes and other criminal activities in Gombe State.

key_facts.fact: NSCDC州指挥官穆罕默德·乌斯曼率团访问EFCC贡贝区域局
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The commitment was made when the NSCDC State Commandant, Mohammad Usman, led a delegation of senior management officers on a familiarisation visit to the EFCC Gombe Zonal Directorate.

key_facts.fact: 双方将情报共享、联合行动和能力建设列为关键合作领域
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Usman identified intelligence and information sharing, joint operations and capacity building as critical areas requiring stronger cooperation among security and law enforcement agencies.

uncertainties: 目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
报道为两机构合作意向，具体行动成效尚未证实
